findings.reader_payoff: The reader can see the clause as more than a crop-deficit denial: it also makes the garden's complete transfer of yield a visible standard of non-withholding.
findings.containment: The ordinary agronomic reading that no produce was diminished remains intact; the garden is not being asserted to possess human moral agency.
